representative_form_factor.chosen_model: Tecan Freedom EVO 150 liquid handling workstation
representative_form_factor.reason: The driver is based on a Tecan EVO LiHa backend, and web search did not surface a clearly reusable public STL/STEP/GLB with repo-safe licensing. The fallback therefore uses the Freedom EVO 150 as a documented real-world reference for the cabinet, open deck, and front safety-panel opening.

sources.title: Tecan Freedom EVO brochure
sources.notes: Provides the clearest official front and angled product imagery used to estimate the open worktable, side columns, X-axis beam, and right-front control console proportions.

sources.title: Tecan Freedom EVO operating manual (overall dimensions)
sources.notes: Web search snippet exposes the overall Freedom EVO 150 envelope used here: 1450 mm width, 980 mm depth, and 1120 mm height.

sources.title: Tecan Freedom EVO operating manual (front safety-panel opening)
sources.notes: Web search snippet exposes the Freedom EVO 150 front safety-panel opening as 1130 x 170 mm, which is used for the front-loading access face.

collision_model.notes: The simplified collision intentionally leaves the central worktable and the front safety-panel opening clear so the pipetting deck and representative SBS handoff positions remain reachable from above and from the front.

access_points.name: pipetting_deck_access_link
access_points.description: Approximate center of the open pipetting deck / worktable surface below the LiHa gantry.
access_points.collision_notes: This frame sits over the intentionally open worktable span between the side columns, in front of the rear cabinet, and below the real gantry beam.

access_points.name: socketTypeGenericSbsFootprint_1_60_1
access_points.description: Left-side representative SBS work position on the exposed pipetting deck.
access_points.collision_notes: This SBS handoff position stays outside the segmented cabinet, side-column, and front-guard collision volumes so vertical approach onto the open deck remains valid.

access_points.name: socketTypeGenericSbsFootprint_2_60_1
access_points.description: Center representative SBS work position on the exposed pipetting deck.
access_points.collision_notes: This centered SBS handoff position shares the same open-deck clearance envelope as the pipetting_deck_access_link.

access_points.name: socketTypeGenericSbsFootprint_3_60_1
access_points.description: Right-side representative SBS work position on the exposed pipetting deck.
access_points.collision_notes: This SBS handoff position remains forward of the rear cabinet and above the collision-free worktable opening.

access_points.name: front_loading_access_link
access_points.description: Approximate center of the front safety-panel opening used for manual deck access and front loading.
access_points.collision_notes: This access face represents the front safety-panel opening and sits in front of the lower front guard collision bar.

access_points.name: control_console_access_link
access_points.description: Approximate center of the right-front console / display interaction area.
access_points.collision_notes: The access frame is intentionally above and slightly forward of the console pedestal collision so the operator interaction zone is not embedded in structure.

access_points.name: rear_service_access_link
access_points.description: Approximate rear service region for utilities and maintenance access.
access_points.collision_notes: The rear service frame is placed just outside the rear cabinet collision envelope for cable, power, and pneumatic access.

notes: No clearly reusable public vendor 3D model for the Freedom EVO / generic Tecan LiHa workstation was found during web search, so this is a segmented fallback mesh rather than an exact OEM model.
The shape is intentionally open at the front and top so the pipetting deck remains visible and the access frames can represent manual loading semantics.
Console placement, deck depth, and rear service center are estimated from official brochure imagery and should be treated as integration references, not factory metrology.
